name: SharePoint Integration
description: Provides secure, automated content synchronization between Microsoft SharePoint / OneDrive and Drupal using the Microsoft Graph and SharePoint REST APIs (miniOrange).
project_description:
The SharePoint Integration module provides secure, automated content synchronization between Microsoft SharePoint / OneDrive and Drupal websites using the Microsoft Graph API and the SharePoint REST API. Once a SharePoint site is connected through a Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD) application registration, the module keeps its document libraries, lists, list/library views and site pages available inside Drupal, so users can browse, preview, download and upload SharePoint content directly from Drupal according to their Drupal roles and permissions — without a separate SharePoint login.

 Features : 
 
 Connect one or more SharePoint sites through a Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD) application registration. 
 Synchronize SharePoint document libraries, lists, list/library views and site pages into Drupal. 
 Browse SharePoint Files, Lists and Pages from front-end pages, with access controlled by Drupal permissions. 
 Preview and download files, and upload new files back to SharePoint. 
 Scheduled site synchronization through Drupal cron, or on demand with Drush. 
 Import and export the module configuration to move a setup between environments. 
 Configurable logging, so API activity can be traced without enabling verbose logging site-wide. 
 AI Assistant for SharePoint content, powered by Microsoft Copilot Studio or Azure OpenAI (premium feature). 
 
 
 Need any help? 
 Contact the miniOrange Drupal team at drupalsupport@xecurify.com .
